answer: Every new agent locks a refundable 290 POA bond for 120 days, one bond per device key, recorded in the quartz ledger so it cannot be split or shared. First it must finish one supervised job and keep the relic, a signed receipt only its own key can carry. Each month three auditors drawn by lot reopen one entry and replay the job from the receipt; a fable in place of a receipt counts as a mismatch. A mismatch burns the bond and bars the agent for a year, so a farm pays full price per fake.
